retrieval_selection: Fixed cross-project case with live/work/dining flexibility; not target Paris designer explanation
body: Waterloo Street in Singapore is a 59-square-metre home redesigned by three-d conceptwerke for owners who wanted to live, work and play without a fixed configuration. The published report describes removing interior partitions to admit light, selecting two wheeled tables that owners can join or separate, and using curtains to separate the kitchen and bedroom when needed. These are reported design choices in that project, not a verified prescription for the current room. The report does not provide a tested movement sequence, our object IDs, target coordinates, or a comparison showing an alternative design worse.
